text:
maya: Quick sync — we need to lock the Q2 Private distro MVP scope today. Customer asks keep coming for customer-managed routing + in-place upgrades. Proposing we narrow MVP: image installer + terraform modules, KMS integration, simple rolling update. Thoughts?
ryan: +1 to narrowing. Full BGP support is big. We can do static route templates + example cloud-router for initial customers.
sophia: Agree. Also add a compatibility matrix for model artifacts (FP16 vs int8) so customers know what to pin.
ajay: For upgrades, we should avoid risky in-place DB schema changes. Recommend blue/green for control plane and rolling for runtime nodes. Will need a migration tool for KV cache migrations.
maya: Good call. Does anyone object to postponing managed BGP/BGP-route-injection to v2? 
olivia: From customer side that's OK if we offer a clear migration path and a short-term workaround (e.g., IP prefix NAT + route templates). A few enterprise customers are fine with that for GA if timeline is solid.
ryan: For rollout strategy: propose "canary header" approach — customers can send X-RI-Canary: 1 to route a small % to new version. We'll build traffic-split in the control plane.
sophia: Also need rollout metrics tied to evals: token-level latency, failure-rate, and a quality check (per-prompt BLEU-ish or similarity). If quality regresses >2% on canary prompts, auto-fallback.
ajay: Ops notes: packaging should support two deployment modes: a) VPC mode (customer-managed subnets) b) Onprem mode (airgapped with offline installer). Each needs different cert/KMS flows.
maya: MVP acceptance criteria (proposed):
- installer image + terraform modules for VPC
- offline installer for onprem with checksum verification
- KMS/HSM integration + sample key policy
- rolling update with canary traffic split and rollback hooks
- docs: upgrade playbook + migration CLI (ri-migrate)
If we hit these, GA.
ryan: Implementation notes: cli example for config we can ship in docs:
```
network:
  mode: customer_vpc
  allowed_cidrs: ["10.0.0.0/16"]
rolling_update:
  strategy: canary
  canary_percent: 10
```
ajay: I'll own the upgrade playbook + ri-migrate prototype. ETA: 3 weeks for alpha.
sophia: I'll own the eval gating + compatibility matrix. Adding two prompt sets: infra-critical and customer-templates. ETA: 2 weeks.
maya: I'll own customer comms + acceptance tests, and coordinate beta customers.
olivia: I'll line up two pilot customers who can test VPC mode and one onprem. Can we promise non-production pilot in Apr?
maya: Yes, aim for Apr pilot.
ops-bot: Reminder — deploy window: infra freeze for private distro code from 1768030000 to 1768110000 (UTC).
ryan: Quick technical question: for KV cache migration, do we checkpoint into object store or stream? Preference is checkpoint -> object store to avoid heavy coupling.
ajay: Checkpoint -> object store (S3/GCS-compatible) with versioned prefixes. ri-migrate will read prefixes and atomically swap pointers.
maya: Decisions captured: postpone managed BGP to v2; MVP = installer + terraform + offline + KMS + canary updates + ri-migrate; owners assigned.
maya: Action items: Ajay create ri-migrate RFC + alpha repo by 1768090000; Sophia publish eval sets + matrix by 1768060000; Ryan prototype traffic-split header and control plane flag by 1768070000; Olivia confirm pilots by 1768055000.
ryan: One more: post-GA we should add a "customer-routing" extension for service-mesh handoff (Envoy + xDS). Not for MVP but we should spec it now.
maya: Agreed, add as backlog item.
olivia: Also add license + compliance checklist for onprem pilots. Customers asked about SOC2/HIPAA notes.
sophia: Noted. Will include compliance test vectors in evals.
maya: Thanks all. I'll update the roadmap doc and ping legal for checklist.
